newsitem.title: USA: SBS to post $11 mln charge for acquisition.
newsitem.headline: SBS to post $11 mln charge for acquisition.

text.p: SBS Technologies Inc said Monday it will post an $11 million charge related to the $24 million acquisition of Bit 3 Computer Corp, which manufactures computer networking and interconnection hardware.
SBS said it expects to incur a significant net loss for the second fiscal quarter of 1997 due to the charge.
SBS said it made an initial cash payment of $20 million for Bit 3. Additional payments of $1 million and $3 million will be paid in 1997 and 1998.

The second quarter charge is based on an assessment by SBS, in conjunction with an independent valuation firm, that $11.0 million of the Bit 3 purchase price represented in-process research and development of purchased technology that does not meet the accounting definition of "completed technology."
For the year ended December 31, 1995, Bit 3 had pretax income of about $4.7 million on sales of $12.5 million.
